title: 15-years Outcomes of Sleeve Gastrectomy on Weight Loss
official: 15-years Outcomes of Sleeve Gastrectomy on Weight Loss
summary: Evaluate the beneficial and harmful effects of sleeve gastrectomy at 15 years in a pioneering center for this surgical technique in France
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients who underwent sleeve gastrectomy between 2004 and 2010

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients under 18 year old, pregnancy
* temporary or permanent under guardians
